property_summary: For any non-empty _tos and matching v lengths, transfer returns true and does not revert iff every low-level call to caddress with selector transferFrom(from, _tos[i], v[i]) succeeds; the test asserts that if transfer did not revert then it returned true.
If C.transfer returns (i.e., does not revert) when given non-empty _tos, it must return true.
For any non-empty _tos with matching v length, C.transfer either reverts or returns true; it never returns false.
